name: Milo Chen
subtitle: Eight years of excellent questions
intro: Keeper of interesting stones. Inspector of puddles. Currently investigating whether snails have favourite places.
description: A fictional childhood collection, told through tiny discoveries and unfinished questions. A life book can begin while most of the life is still ahead.
heroAlt: Close-up of dark green leaves with delicate pale pink and white veins
heroCaption: An illustrative nature photograph. Milo and these memories are entirely fictional.
quote: Can we look a bit closer?
